description: “Apple has recovered billions of dollars previously paid out in now-annulled tariffs, though its customers appear unlikely to benefit from the windfall. On Thursday, the company released its third-quarter results, once again beating Wall Street forecasts for revenue and earnings per share and celebrating what CEO Tim Cook said was its ‘strongest June quarter ever.'” […]
title: Corporations Get Refunds While Americans Struggle with Soaring Costs - Deborah K. Ross
